notes: Tuition: pages state the programme has no study fees (studiengebührenfreie Rahmenbedingungen; 'Die Hochschule Fulda erhebt keine Studiengebühren'), only a semester contribution (~400 EUR), so amountMinor 0. Intakes: the deadlines are for the winter and summer semester but the pages do not give a year; no year has been inferred, so the ISO dates are illustrative and should be verified. Application channel: the pages say to apply via the central application page ('Wie und wann muss ich mich bewerben?' / 'Bewerben mit internationalen Zeugnissen') but do not name uni-assist or a VPD, so applicationChannel is omitted and this must be checked manually.
